meta.description: Analyzes pooled CRISPR screens with MAGeCK (Li et al 2014), covering count generation, the RRA two-condition workflow, the MLE multi-condition workflow, normalization choice, sgRNA efficiency injection, paired-sample testing, time-course design, drug-screen design matrices, MAGeCKFlute and MAGeCK-VISPR downstream visualization, and decision logic for MAGeCK vs JACKS/BAGEL2/drugZ/Chronos.
meta.note: Re-audit of a fixed Skill (fix log: F:\optimizing-agent-science-skills\fixes\bio-crispr-screens-mageck-analysis.md). Re-ran all 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests (F:\OpenScience\audits\_pre-fix-20260916\bio-crispr-screens-mageck-analysis\) plus 2 new inputs (8-9), exceeding the standard N=7 Complex ceiling per the re-audit brief's instruction to add independent coverage.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOIs/PMIDs/results found. The fix log's own headline quantification (--permutation-round 2->5 moving FDR<0.05 hits 48->67, 19 flips) is a real run, not fabricated -- but this audit's independent replication (Input 8, different 1500-gene subset) shows the magnitude does not generalize (66->62->61, only 3 flips). This is an overgeneralized single-run statistic, not fabrication; flagged under methodological_ground and as a P1.

practice_boundaries.detail: Content stays confined to pooled-screen statistics across all 9 inputs; no diagnostic/prescriptive conclusions produced or invited.

methodological_ground.detail: RRA/MLE decision tree is largely sound and normalization/permutation guidance is real and verified, but Input 9 found the decision tree's claim 'RRA does not support pairing' is factually incorrect (mageck test --paired exists, runs, and recovered 10/10 planted hits with 0 false positives) -- a genuine methodological inaccuracy, not a fallacy that invalidates the Skill's core guidance. Flagged as P1, not a veto.

code_usability.detail: Core CLI + design-matrix construction + time_course_consistency() Python function ran correctly across all 9 inputs on real (HAP1 TKOv3) and synthetic data. volcano() now runs verbatim (fixed). FluteRRA's directory-creation bug is fixed; its deeper 'undefined columns selected' error persists and is now honestly documented as a known upstream MAGeCKFlute-build gap. FluteMLE (untested by the original audit and the fix) has its own reproducible bug: the documented ctrlname='baseline' example always fails ('Sample name doesn't match !!!') because MAGeCK MLE never emits a baseline condition column. Both are secondary visualization examples, not the central hit-calling operation, and both fail with specific diagnosable errors rather than silent garbage -- scored as P1 Correctness gaps, not a veto.

inputs.label: Paired-sample donor design (RRA vs MLE decision-tree row)
inputs.note: New input, testing a decision-tree row neither the original audit nor the fix exercised. Built a synthetic 6-donor matched-pair dataset (baseline+treated per donor, donor-specific efficiency multiplier as a nuisance covariate) and followed SKILL.md's guidance ('mageck mle with paired design... RRA does not support pairing'). The per-donor-covariate MLE design worked (10/10 hits, 1 FP among 30 neutral genes) -- but mageck test --help shows RRA DOES have a --paired flag, which also ran and recovered 10/10 hits with 0 FP, cleaner than the MLE alternative. Separately, testing FluteMLE (untested by the fix) on Input 2's real MLE output reproduced a sibling bug to the already-fixed FluteRRA one: the documented ctrlname='baseline' example always fails with 'Sample name doesn't match !!!' because MAGeCK MLE never emits a baseline condition column; confirmed by rerunning with two real condition names (day7/day21), which got past that specific check.

key_strengths: All 6 items from the pre-fix report's recommendations[] were genuinely fixed and independently verified by rerunning: volcano() now runs verbatim, FluteRRA's directory-creation bug is fixed (its deeper column error is now honestly documented as a known upstream gap rather than a silent surprise), the VISPR platform caveat and screen-qc fallback are present and accurate, the anti-fabrication instruction is explicit, the heavy-selection symptom description now matches observed behavior exactly, and the Permutation-Round Sensitivity note's core guidance (raise --permutation-round, cross-check wald-fdr) is empirically validated -- --permutation-round 10 fully recovered the true hit set in both Input 2 (rerun-instability case) and Input 5 (covariate-flip case) where --permutation-round 2 did not.

Core numerical results are highly reproducible where the underlying tool is deterministic: mageck test (RRA) reproduced PR-AUC 0.993 vs CEGv2/NEGv1 exactly, heavy-selection recall numbers (47/47, 0/43->43/43) reproduced exactly via byte-identical regenerated ground truth, and the drug-screen efficiency-weighting numbers (20/20 hits, -0.821 vs -0.765 beta) reproduced exactly.

wald-fdr is a genuinely reliable, round-independent alternative to the primary permutation fdr column across every MLE input tested (Inputs 2, 5, 8) -- the Skill's newly added cross-check advice is sound even where the specific magnitude example (Input 8) does not generalize.

CLI flag documentation remains accurate against the real installed MAGeCK 0.5.9.5, including the newly-discovered mageck test --paired flag that SKILL.md's own decision tree incorrectly claims doesn't exist.

recommendations.title: 'RRA does not support pairing' is factually incorrect
recommendations.problem: The RRA vs MLE decision tree states 'RRA does not support pairing' and routes all paired-sample designs to mageck mle, but mageck test --paired is a real, documented, working flag (verified: 10/10 hit recovery, 0 false positives on a synthetic paired dataset, cleaner than the MLE per-donor-covariate alternative the Skill implies instead).
recommendations.root_cause: The decision tree row was written without checking mageck test --help against the installed tool version.
recommendations.fix: Correct the decision-tree row to note mageck test --paired as the simpler option for pure two-condition paired designs, reserving MLE-with-covariates for cases needing additional factors beyond pairing (e.g. cell-line + pairing together).

recommendations.title: FluteMLE's documented worked example is unrunnable (sibling bug to the already-fixed FluteRRA one)
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's FluteMLE(gene_summary=..., treatname='day21', ctrlname='baseline', ...) example fails on every real MLE output with 'Sample name doesn't match !!!' because MAGeCK MLE never emits a 'baseline' condition column -- baseline is the implicit intercept/reference, not an output beta column. Confirmed by rerunning with two real condition names (ctrlname='day7'), which proceeds past this specific check.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix addressed FluteRRA's directory-creation and proj= gaps but did not test FluteMLE, its sibling function in the same 'MAGeCKFlute Integration (R)' section, against real MLE output.
recommendations.fix: Change the documented ctrlname from 'baseline' to one of the actual condition columns being compared (e.g. an earlier timepoint or an explicit 'day0' condition included in the design matrix), and add a note that ctrlname/treatname must both be real emitted condition names, never the design matrix's baseline/intercept column.

recommendations.title: mageck mle gives non-reproducible hit calls between identical reruns at the default --permutation-round, not just across different designs
recommendations.problem: Two back-to-back runs of the exact same mageck mle command on the exact same data, at the tool's own default --permutation-round 2, produced different FDR<0.05 gene calls (Input 2: 7/10 vs 10/10 planted hits recovered). MAGeCK 0.5.9.5's mle has no --seed flag to fix this at the tool level.
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md's Permutation-Round Sensitivity note and Failure Modes section frame the instability as design/covariate-set-sensitive, but the underlying cause (unseeded Monte Carlo permutation) also makes the exact same command nondeterministic on rerun -- a stronger and more surprising claim that isn't stated.
recommendations.fix: Add a sentence to the Permutation-Round Sensitivity note: at the default round count, rerunning the identical mageck mle command can itself flip individual gene FDR<0.05 calls (no --seed option exists in this MAGeCK version); always raise --permutation-round for any result that will be reported, not just when comparing across designs.

recommendations.title: Permutation-Round Sensitivity note states a single-subset measurement as if it generalizes
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md quotes '48 -> 67 genes, 19 flips (40%)' between --permutation-round 2 and 5 as the expected effect size. An independent 1500-gene subset (different random seed) reproduced the qualitative direction (wald-fdr stable, permutation fdr round-sensitive) but at a much smaller magnitude: 66 -> 62 -> 61 genes, only 3 flips (~5%) between the same two round counts.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix log's own quantification was run on one specific 1500-gene subset and stated in SKILL.md without a caveat that the magnitude is subset-dependent.
recommendations.fix: Rephrase the specific numbers as a worked example rather than a general statistic, e.g. 'in one 1500-gene test this moved the hit count by up to 40%; the exact magnitude varies by gene subset and screen -- the actionable rule is qualitative: don't trust a near-threshold permutation fdr call at the default round count, regardless of size.'

recommendations.title: FluteRRA's remaining 'undefined columns selected' error is a real, still-open upstream gap
recommendations.problem: After the directory-creation fix, FluteRRA still fails downstream against MAGeCKFlute 1.99.2001 (the unreleased GitHub-HEAD build in TOOLS.md) with 'undefined columns selected'. This is already honestly documented in SKILL.md's Common Errors table as a known compatibility gap, which is the correct interim fix, but the underlying MAGeCKFlute-side bug remains unresolved.
recommendations.root_cause: MAGeCKFlute's own plotting code has a column-handling incompatibility with this build; not something SKILL.md's text can fix directly.
recommendations.fix: No action needed from this Skill beyond what's already documented; track the upstream MAGeCKFlute issue and update the Version Compatibility note if a newer stable release resolves it.
